description: This file defines an Angular component named 'ViewerTransactionsComponent' for displaying and filtering transaction data in a UI, including templates, styles, and event handling logic.

classes.name: ViewerTransactionsComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for viewing and filtering transactions, with UI templates and styles.

methods.name: inputData
methods.description: Setter for input data, updates the component state and scrolls to a specified index if provided.

methods.name: onVSyncIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the VSync ID filter, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onPidFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the PID filter, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onUidFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the UID filter, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onTypeFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the type filter, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onLayerIdFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to the layer/display ID filter, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onWhatSearchStringChange
methods.description: Handles updates to the search text for filtering, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onIdSearchStringChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the transaction ID search text, emitting corresponding event.

methods.name: onEntryClicked
methods.description: Triggers when a transaction entry is clicked, emitting the index.

methods.name: isCurrentEntry
methods.description: Checks if the given index is the currently selected entry.

methods.name: isSelectedEntry
methods.description: Checks if the given index is the highlighted entry.
